messages:
jake-support: FYI escalating CobaltHealth onboarding — private deploy failed provisioning, customer can't run smoke tests, saying it's blocking go-live and renewal is in 45 days. Requested P1. Tickets: INC-9821. Details below.

maria-cs: Thanks Jake. I'll own CS comms. Can you paste the failing logs and exact error? Need impact summary for exec. Also: do we have a workaround for the customer?

arun-se: Reproduced. Hit on VM init step — gce-boot times out when pulling model shard. Error: "pull_shard_timeout=120s". Working on increasing timeout and retry policy. No data loss. No token leak. Short-term patch possible.

jake-support: repro steps and logs:
```
2026-03-18T15:04:08Z kubelet: pull shard failed: context deadline exceeded
/var/log/serve: model shard 42 failed to download
curl https://storage.redwood/models/v1/... -> 504
```
Customer tried restart, same result.

taylor-ae: I'm on standby. If we can't fix in 4h, we should offer a temporary hosted fallback and credit for downtime. CC @VP-sales.

maria-cs: Comms plan draft:
- 30m: update customer that engineering is investigating; give ETA 2-4h
- 2h: provide mitigation (hosted fallback) + exec contact
- 24h: follow-up with RCA deliverable and proposed fix timetable
Assign: arun = fix owner, jake = support lead, taylor = commercial/credit
I'll lead customer updates and exec comms.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-9821. Priority: P1. Pager duty: eng-oncall.

arun-se: Short-term action: increasing shard pull timeout to 300s and add 3 retry attempts. Deploying now to staging, will test and push to prod if green.

jake-support: Customer on standby for update. They've asked for a call at 17:00 PST.

maria-cs: OK scheduled. I'll join with taylor + arun. I'll send calendar invite and a one-pager for the execs. Anyone else?

taylor-ae: I'll prep credit numbers and fallback pricing. :+1:

arun-se: Patch looks good in staging, pushing to prod. Will post status in 15m.

jake-support: Thanks all. Keeping customer calm — they said renewal review is next month, they're sensitive. Please prioritize.

maria-cs: Noted. Exec visibility on the call. After prod patch, I'll follow with comms and ask for extension on renewal if they want more time. End.
